verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only CKS Node Pool autoscaling through the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler. That scales managed bare-metal Kubernetes nodes, not serverless GPU workers, and nothing documents scale-to-zero or a serverless deploy-code model. This is an adjacent infrastructure feature and earns no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances

citations.quote: CKS supports scaling Node Pools by using the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler
